sloka: स सागरं दानवपन्नगायुतं ।बलेन विक्रम्य महोर्मिमालिनम् ।निपत्य तीरे च महोदधेस्तदा ।ददर्श लङ्काममरावतीमिव ॥५-१-२१०॥
transliteration: sa sāgaraṁ dānavapannagāyutaṁ ।balena vikramya mahormimālinam ।nipatya tīre ca mahodadhestadā ।dadarśa laṅkāmamarāvatīmiva ॥5-1-210॥

translations.english: Having overleapt by his strength the ocean filled with danavas and serpents and garlanded with great waves, he alighted on the shore of the great sea and beheld Lanka, which was like Amaravati.
